big_case.notes: Solicitor General petition from a final D.C. Circuit judgment holding unlawful Proclamation 10,888's entry suspension and asylum preclusion at the southern border, with a 1252(f)(1) classwide-relief question; the Court granted plenary review limited to QPs 1 and 2 on 2026-11-13. Among the highest-stakes immigration and executive-power cases of the Term.
